notes.title: Pechka Release Schedule Announcement
notes.content:
Pechka Release Schedule Announcement

Hello?
Pechka is scheduled to be released on Steam on 7/14 00:00 (PST).
Thank you to everyone who has been patiently waiting.

notes.title: 'Pechka' Demo play LIVE streaming
notes.content:
We will commence the live streaming of the 'Pechka' demo version for one hour at 6 PM (PST) on June 20th.
Please show a lot of interest.
